correctness.rationale: For stationary binary Markov labels with switch probability h/2, I_n=∑_{i<j}1(S_i=+,S_j=-) gives exact n²/8 +(∑(n+1-2i)S_i)/4 -(∑S_i)²/8. Correlation E S_iS_j=p^{|i-j|} gives mean; zero inversions means no switch or unique ascending switch, giving exact atom. Gaussian regime uses martingale differences D_k=S_k-pS_{k-1} with deterministic variance 1-p², triangular Lindeberg when nh→∞, and M_n² term negligible, with variance scale n³(1+p)/(48h). For nh→λ, independent Bernoulli switch positions converge to rate λ/2 Poisson process giving telegraph inversion-area and atom. For nh→0, one descending switch dominates I>0 and yields U(1-U). Independently enumerated all 2^n label words for n=2..8 with exact rational probabilities at p=0,1/2,3/4; identities verified. This finite test supplements analytical limit arguments.
